title: Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority / Workout Plan / Timely Invoice Processing / Progress of Outstanding Invoices
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA) and City Administrative Officer (CAO), with the assistance of HR&A advisors, the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD), Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority (LAHSA), and City Controller, report within 15 days on an administrative workout plan to effectuate timely processing of invoices. 1 FURTHER MOVE that the CLA and CAO, with assistance from HR&A advisors, LAHD, and LAHSA, report on progress with the payment of outstanding invoices, including a breakout of outstanding payments by time, status, program, contract number, and funding source.
